Download
Download

Free trial for Windows.

Free, no account and no card. Installation takes a minute, and you'll have your first cabinet with a cut list in five.

TOPICA-trial.exe · 0.1 (probna) · ~15 MB · Without e-mail: download directly

What your computer needs

SystemWindows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit.
ComputerAn ordinary workshop laptop is enough: 4 GB of memory and graphics that can run 3D in a browser.
InternetNot needed. The program works offline and creates no account.

Installation in three steps

Space for a screenshot of this step (added by the owner)
1

Double-click the downloaded file TOPICA-trial.exe.

Space for a screenshot of this step (added by the owner)
2

If Windows asks whether you trust the program, click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.

Space for a screenshot of this step (added by the owner)
3

Open TOPICA from the desktop. Create your first project: enter the room sizes and place the first cabinet.

Windows warning. The program is not yet digitally signed, so on first launch Windows shows a blue “Windows protected your PC” screen. This is normal for new, unsigned programs: click “More info”, then “Run anyway”. We are obtaining a signature and the warning will disappear.
